item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable evidence that Scholz used fabricated intelligence, historical grievance, or misinformation to mobilize conflict support.\nI also did not find a direct audit of his classified intelligence claims, so “truthfulness” here is judged from his public record and credible reporting, not from internal files.","evidence":[{"title":"Scholz calls G7 plan to use Russian windfall profits for Ukraine’s defence ‘historic’","publisher":"Reuters","date":"13 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/scholz-calls-g7-plan-to-use-russian-windfall-profits-for-ukraines-defence-historic/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjQ6bmV3c21sX1ZBMDQyNTEzMDYyMDI0UlAx","summary":"Scholz described Putin’s objective as continuing the war until supporters abandon Ukraine, then said the G7 plan would help Ukraine obtain needed weapons and reconstruction funding.
